primitives.name: Restraining Line Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: After the Referee blows his whistle signifying that play may' start, no player of the kicking side shall advance beyond a line passing through the mark of the catch and parallel to the goal line with the ball in his possession.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: x: longitudinal distance along the field (meters), x_0: mark of the catch (meters).
primitives.assumptions: Euclidean field geometry; rigid, perfectly straight restraining line.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs if the mark of the catch is undefined or lies outside the valid field boundaries.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a hard-wall potential barrier in quantum mechanics or a strict inequality constraint in convex optimization.
layer2.telemetry: Real-time tracking of player centroid coordinates relative to x_0.

primitives.name: Ground Contact Nullifier
primitives.verbatim_quote: After the Referee blows his whistle signifying that play may start, no player of the kicking side shall allow the bal to touch the ground in the field of play, without immediately thereafter putting it in play by kicking it.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: z_ball: vertical height of the ball (meters), t: time (seconds), dt_kick: time interval between ground contact and kick (seconds).
primitives.assumptions: Continuous temporal sampling; 'immediately' implies dt_kick approaches zero within a defined tolerance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails under extreme wind conditions where aerodynamic lift mimics a delayed kick, or sensor noise obscures z_ball = 0.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a discontinuous event-triggered kernel in hybrid dynamical systems, forcing an immediate state change upon boundary collision.
layer2.telemetry: High-frequency altitude telemetry and velocity vector analysis at the moment of ground contact.

primitives.name: Penalty Translation Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: PENALTY (REFEREE) The ball must be kicked from some point at least 5 yards back of the original mark and a new restraining line for the opponents shall be established 5 yards nearer the original mark.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: delta_x: fixed penalty translation distance (4.572 meters), x_new: new origin coordinate (meters).
primitives.assumptions: Translation is strictly linear along the primary axis of the field; delta_x is constant.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Boundary singularity if the translated coordinate pushes the ball off the playing surface entirely.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a Lagrangian multiplier penalty function shifting the feasible region of the optimization problem upon constraint violation.
layer2.telemetry: Verification of the new spot marker placement via computer vision relative to the previous mark.
